assessment: The same single-page Bilibili P1 is cited by both the KarmaZoo and 大侠立志传 baseline entries. Its t≈600 sample shows a Steam library/desktop view, and t≈12000/15000 show 大侠立志传-style scenes; these samples support 大侠立志传 content at the tested positions but do not establish that the whole P1 lacks KarmaZoo. The existing AcFun source shows KarmaZoo at t≈600, while a newly identified, unlinked single-page Bilibili P2 candidate shows KarmaZoo at t≈12000. The two KarmaZoo points differ and do not establish exact correspondence, coverage, session continuity or page-boundary alignment. The candidate may provide additional evidence for the KarmaZoo entry, but must not be added automatically.
limitations: Only three points in the shared P1, one point in AcFun, and one point in the candidate P2 were checked; all other page content remains unobserved.
No audio was listened to; no full-page or full-session continuity/completeness review was made.
The two Bilibili submissions have publication timestamps on 2023-11-22; those timestamps do not independently authenticate the session date.
